results.watch: Sheet case 2. Digital arrest is not a real legal procedure. Disconnect, do not transfer money or share Aadhaar and bank details, and do not treat the caller as a real officer.

replies: If the call is still on, hang up now. You do not have to stay on it.

This sounds like a digital arrest scam, where fraudsters pretend to be police or other authorities to scare you into sharing personal details. Real police will never ask you for your Aadhaar or bank details over the phone to prove your innocence.
